scientific_integrity: An exact analytic theorem with independent finite numerical checks; not independently audited, and no claim of human or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Annealed stationary spin correlations, not quenched conditional on a fixed reset template.
Independent identically distributed Bernoulli initial spins; finite-mean global Pareto inter-reset intervals with exponent greater than one.
Infinite one-dimensional nearest-neighbor Glauber/voter chain; no higher-dimensional or non-Markovian inter-reset spin dynamics.
Positive-temperature common-age covariance plateau is not claimed as independently novel.
Possible implicit or unindexed consequences in classical renewal and coalescing duality remain an originality risk.
title: Algebraic spatial clustering from global Pareto resetting in the one-dimensional Glauber chain
